description: Elenco parcheggi zona Stazione - Chieri is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Piemonte. Il dataset contiene l’elenco dei parcheggi presenti nella zona adiacente alla Stazione di Chieri. Per ciascuno è disponibile il numero di stalli, se pagamento/liberi/disco orario, numero di stalli per disabili, geolocalizzazione ed eventuali note. Coverage: Regione Piemonte. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Piemonte. Its tags are trasporto. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
